logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Verification chart for WO-01 (B memo to C): horizontal bar chart of measured acceptance-run energy for the four qualified pump modules on the common flow and head basis. Bars: P2 12 kWh highlighted green as the lowest-energy qualifying pick; P3 52, P1 56, P4 58 kWh in muted blue-gray, each annotated with its trusted-table quality index and raw defect count. Gridlines every 10 kWh. A dashed amber outline marks P4 as A's 'flagged sensitivity alternative', labeled as a flagged open question rather than client evidence. A lower audit panel lists B's verification findings with colored markers: verified eligibility, ordering, gaps and P2 selection; verified exclusion of unverified cost/delivery items; the incorrect P1 quality-margin claim; the six-gate register that traces to no supplied source; the six-initial 'signature' whose length matches the validation-tag format (no tag letters are ever rendered); and the missing illustration in the delivered document. No validation tag letters appear anywhere in the image.
